main.description: A photo of a track or review (com.hikeratlas.temp.defs#photo), as an image: a thumbnail, or the photo itself, from its author's PDS through a cache. Only photos of records the indexer has, and hasn't hidden. Served by Hiker Atlas's indexer (https://github.com/hikeratlas/atproto-indexer). In beta: may change.

size.description: thumbnail: at most 640 pixels a side; fullsize: the photo as uploaded.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Not a photo of a record the indexer has, or hidden.
